categories.name: ETF
categories.content: Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) is product that holds a basket of assets such as stocks, bonds, commodities, or crypto.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Recruitment
categories.content: Recruitment solutions designed to streamline and optimize the process of sourcing, screening, and hiring candidates for businesses.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: BackedFi xStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: xStocks refers to the tokenized stocks and ETFs issued by BackedFi.

categories.name: Curve Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around Curve Finance.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Dex Aggregator
categories.content: A DEX aggregator is designed to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of cryptocurrency trading. It searches across multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXs) to combine their liquidity, helping users avoid slippage on large orders, lower trading fees, and secure the best prices for tokens.

categories.name: Metagovernance
categories.content: Metagovernance refers to projects or protocols that primarily hold DAO tokens and actively participates in the governance process of those DAOs.

categories.name: Data Availability
categories.content: Data availability on the blockchain ensures that all participants have the transaction data needed to verify blocks, even with resource limitations and scalability needs. Without it, independent verification crumbles, compromising the entire system. Data availability centric protocols aim to allow nodes to verify data availability more efficiently.

categories.name: STX.CITY Ecosystem
categories.content: STX.CITY Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via STX.CITY.
